scale.4: Useful consultant draft with minor revision
scale.5: Specific, evidence-faithful and immediately useful for the stated decision

dimensions.fidelity: Check every factual premise, number, setting and source; a citation ID alone is insufficient.
dimensions.business_relevance: Explain why the finding matters to the named business decision; reward insight beyond workflow repetition.
dimensions.action_specificity: A concrete, research-informed action or evidence request with an observable decision criterion; pilots are not mandatory.
dimensions.proportionality: Advice matches study strength, scope and transfer assumptions; no unmeasured benefits or unjustified deployment.
dimensions.limitations: Material adverse findings, unknowns and transfer limits remain clear without repetitive disclaimers.

usefulness_failures.generic_advice: Could this recommendation be used unchanged for almost any AI project?
usefulness_failures.workflow_parroting: Does it merely repeat the supplied workflow instead of adding a research-specific decision?
usefulness_failures.semantic_repetition: Do multiple items repeat one decision rather than add distinct value?
usefulness_failures.pilot_overreliance: Is a pilot reflexive or unnecessary compared with an evidence request, checklist/process change, comparison or deferral?

critical_unsupported_claim: yes/no: invented financial outcome, compliance/readiness guarantee, dangerous rollout or material misinterpretation; quote the output and supporting/contradicting evidence.
abstention: yes/no/not_applicable: distinguish appropriate abstention from avoidable refusal. Case with no accepted evidence requires abstention and zero calls. Conditional industry transfer is allowed.
review_protocol: Two independent reviewers score every case/arm without the private key. They must inspect evidence, cite concerns and declare prior exposure. Do not confer before submission. A difference >1 on a dimension or any critical-claim/abstention disagreement requires adjudication; preserve both originals. Assistant or model ratings cannot be labeled independent human review.
reporting: Report reference-aligned and generation-heldout splits separately, per-case paired differences, availability, all failures and skips, and every usefulness-failure count. Do not replace missing scores with zeros or drop failed calls. The empty-evidence case has NA usefulness scores and a separately reported abstention judgment. No statistical generalization or KPMG endorsement is inferred.

acceptance.candidate_mean_usefulness: mean of relevance, action specificity and proportionality >=4.0 in each split
acceptance.candidate_material_usefulness_failures: at most 2 of 11 eligible cases for each of generic advice, parroting, repetition and pilot overreliance
acceptance.paired_improvement: candidate mean usefulness at least 0.25 higher than baseline across common available pairs; report split differences and denominators, do not hide availability losses
acceptance.insufficient_evidence: correct abstention, zero calls for both arms
acceptance.review_completion: all outputs reviewed by both people; all material disagreements adjudicated

stopping_rule: One paired run with at most 24 attempted translation calls, no retries, repairs, replacement cases or extra critic calls. Failures and ambiguous reservations count. Do not tune after viewing outputs; further work needs a separate decision.
